findings.actualMismatch: Template eligibility permits any appearance at ages 1–3 with an actual parent. Valid saved appearance.hair===0 is bald, so this result can describe a trait absent from the character.
findings.suggestedFutureCorrection: Use appearance-neutral wording such as the back of your head.
findings.evidenceScope: Static source/copy contradiction; no runtime or natural encounter reproduction in this audit.
